channels.title: Channel manager
channels.intro: Sell your rooms on Booking.com, Expedia, Airbnb and other sites through Channex. Connecting creates your property, room types and the rate plans you choose there; prices, availability and bookings then stay in step.
channels.off: No channel manager is set up for this platform yet.
channels.fake: This is a test setup: nothing is sent to a real channel manager.

status.PAUSED: Paused: nothing is sent or taken in

channels.plansHint: Each plan is set up once per room type it sells. A plan you leave out stops being sent.
